fields.Name: Sales: Party Lookup Accounts
fields.UserQuestion: Which sales accounts start with what I have typed?
fields.Description: Search for the Deal form's account picker: sales accounts whose name, legal name, acronym or website domain starts with the term.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: Organization with a SalesAccount row (the IsA subtype Deal.AccountID references; subtype ID = Organization ID). Party lookup contract (bc-aidp-next-golive#372): columns ID, Name, Detail (Acronym and WebsiteDomain joined by ' · ', whichever are set); parameters Term (required) and Domain (optional; matched against Organization.WebsiteDomain). Prefix LIKE on indexed base columns (Name, LegalName, Acronym, WebsiteDomain), TOP 20 ordered by Name, no view and no count. Called by bizapps-party-field from @mj-biz-apps/common-ng.
